consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, which asks 'does crafting_inventory hold >=20 scrap?' to decide if the find-item objective is satisfied
scope: items reachable nearby for crafting (crafting_inventory: carried plus adjacent map/vehicle/appliance sources within crafting reach), not only the character's own carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — calls u.crafting_inventory() then tmp_inv.has_amount(item_id,item_count) (falling back to has_charges) and returns the resulting yes/no completion verdict
divergence: 20 scrap sit on adjacent ground (or in a neighboring vehicle) within crafting reach but none in the avatar's worn/wielded/carried inventory: the correct crafting_inventory check returns complete=true, while an on-person possession check of the wrong reach returns false
